comments.author: Royal-Somewhere-8918
comments.body: The planet and nebula are close in brightness, so the silhouette gets lost on a phone. Before changing generators, I'd try a single directional light, a restrained rim/atmosphere and a darker, quieter backdrop. Keep the same camera and ask Claude + Blender for three lighting/material variants, changing one variable at a time. Compare them at the actual phone size with the UI visible; a detailed close-up can still become muddy once scaled down.
